title: Ethiopian Kitfo Stew
description: A vegetarian twist on traditional Ethiopian kitfo, featuring beef alternative kicked beef.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add berbere spice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add sliced Kicked beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add vegetable broth, diced tomatoes, cilantro, peppercorns, and salt.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve hot over injera or rice.
Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
Squeeze a wedge of lime over the top, if desired.
